snippet.title: Petunia's Purgatory - Creepy Farming Idle Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4009450/Petunias_Purgatory/

Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute, idle-farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds that grow into horrifying crops, sacrifice animals for blood, and summon assistants to help you run your farm. Manage your sanity while you try to appease the Elder God!
